author: spidey simp
description: A collection of API-powered Discord utilities and games, including cat and dog profiles, jokes, advice, trivia, free-to-play game discovery, DiceBear avatars, and random insults.
install_msg: Thank you for installing WorldOfApis! Use `[p]load worldofapis`, then `/woa` commands to explore the available API-powered tools. Some features may require additional API configuration.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no end user data persistently. Trivia preferences are temporarily associated with Discord user IDs in memory and are cleared when the cog reloads.
